about: Which color is drawn on which color, for tools/design/contrast.py. Names are those of docs/spec/1-tokens.md without the 'color.' head. Every fg is checked against every name in bg. 'except' lists the themes where the owner decided to keep a pair under its minimum, and why (printed, never failing). 'where' says where the screen draws it (spec 2 and 3, ui/src/components CSS and the WebGL rgb("color.…") calls).

text.about: Text on its ground (WCAG 2 SC 1.4.3, AA, normal size).

ui.about: A mark, a meaningful line or border, or an on mark, against the color next to it (WCAG 2 SC 1.4.11).

state.about: The on color against the off color of the same mark, where color is what shows the change.

disabled.about: Text of 「使えない」 parts. WCAG does not ask for a ratio for inactive parts; they must still be readable.

line.about: Lines that show structure but are not the only way to tell it: bar lines, strong dividers, button, clip and box borders.

grid.about: Thin lines that only have to be seen clearly: beat lines, thin dividers.

faint.about: The faintest decoration: sub-beat lines, neighbouring fills (white and black key rows, white and black keys, panels next to bands), borders of 「使えない」 parts.

fill.about: Large neighbouring fills that carry a meaning. WCAG has no number for large fills. 3:1 cannot be reached here by values alone without lighting up the whole work area (see the note on scale lock in docs/spec/1-tokens.md).

note.about: Shown for reference, never fails: on and off colors of text where the words or a border also change, and colors told apart by hue and place.
